required_secrets.name: tenant_id
required_secrets.purpose: Which Microsoft 365 organisation to sign in to. Not a secret in the usual sense, and kept here so every part of the sign-in lives in one place.

required_secrets.name: client_id
required_secrets.purpose: The Entra application registration Aurora signs in as. Public identifier of the app you created.

required_secrets.name: refresh_token
required_secrets.purpose: Acts as you, with the permissions you consented to. Anything Aurora does with Microsoft is done as you and is attributable to you. Obtained once by running device_login.py yourself; Aurora never asks for your password.

capabilities.title: Microsoft connection status
capabilities.description: Whether this machine could reach Microsoft 365 at all, and what is missing if not. Answers without contacting Microsoft, so it is safe to ask before anything has been approved.

capabilities.title: Who Aurora is signed in as
capabilities.description: The signed-in account's name, address, job title and department, read from the Microsoft directory. Reads only. A job title here is a fact about a directory entry and never a reason to allow anything.
